description: Is Dø Desktop running on the user's Mac and connected to their DAW? Reports which sessions it currently holds, whether a live Logic hook is answering, and its per-session applied cursor. Use it to know whether an edit will reach the DAW live now (desktop online + logic connected) or wait for the next session open. When it is NOT connected the result says how the user gets and pairs the app, and what still works without it. Read-only.
name: doseedo_desktop_status
